lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Hey,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: got any decent game recommendations?
There's nothing wrong with gaming, but some physical activity wouldn't kill you.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Sitting still won't kill me either.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: So are you a more active person?
Somewhat.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Well, as you know, hackers aren't exactly the most physically fit bunch.
I just don't think being lethargic is good for the body.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I said it once, and I'll say it again.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It's not like a lack of exercise will kill me.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I'm a Nikke, after all.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I also get regular check-ups.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You don't need to worry.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Has there ever been a time where my job suffered as a result from inactivity?
That's not what I'm concerned about.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Okay, fine.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: How about this?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Novel had me join her on one of her detective cases,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and I spent the entire day wandering around outside.
Did something bad happen?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: No, it was fine.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I was pretty exhausted when it was over though, moreso than I am on a regular mission.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: When I got back, I passed out without even playing any games.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: My conclusion?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Exercise is for the birds. Playing games while plastered to the couch is where it's at.
You can increase your stamina by exercising.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You are nothing if not persistent.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: There's only one thing I can do.
What's that?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Run away.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Byyyyeeeeee!
